lineage.strategy: Acquire recent issuer-distributed order/backlog and cash evidence to address execution and demand visibility.

observations.fact: Powell reported fiscal Q3 2026 revenue of $312 million (+9% YoY), gross margin of 30.6%, net income of $52 million, and $100 million of operating cash flow.

New orders were $934 million (+158% YoY), backlog reached $2.4 billion (+69%), and the quarter included three mega orders: a data-center award above $400 million, roughly $75 million petrochemical, and roughly $60 million LNG.
Cash and short-term investments were $634 million at June 30, 2026.

risks.risk: Backlog conversion is project-timing dependent and a >$400 million data-center award creates material single-project execution exposure even as end-market bookings broaden.

unknowns.unknown: The release does not provide project-level margin, cancellation exposure or precise revenue-conversion timing for each mega order.

recommendation: Use as direct numeric demand, profitability, liquidity and backlog evidence; preserve project-conversion and concentration risks in underwriting.
